name: normpdf
expr: y_default = normpdf(xs); y_mu5 = normpdf(xs + 5, 5, 1); y_sig2 = normpdf(xs * 2, 0, 2); y_at_peak = normpdf(2.5, 2, 0.5); y_sigbad = normpdf(1, 0, 0); y_signeg = normpdf(1, 0, -1);
comment: Sig: y = normpdf(x[, mu, sigma]). Normal PDF: (1/(σ√(2π)))·exp(-(x-μ)²/(2σ²)). Defaults mu=0, sigma=1. sigma<=0 => NaN. Vectorised.
